verdict.en: Ronald Reagan remains a conditional investigation. Nearby supply and regional usage support testing the opportunity, but neither 59 paid sessions per day, 35 billed kWh per session nor a controllable 150 kW 4CP has been established. The combined investment hurdle still fails.
verdict.zh: Ronald Reagan继续作为有条件调查对象。附近供给及区域使用情况支持继续检验机会，但每天59次付费充电、每次计费35kWh及可控的150kW 4CP均未获本地证实；联合投资门槛仍未通过。

scope.en: This focused update checks nearby comparators, demand units, PEC peak billing and complete-cost scope. It preserves the earlier 37 formal decisions and every admission threshold. Operator pages verify equipment, not sales; regional aggregates are not local forecasts.
scope.zh: 本轮集中核查附近参照站、需求口径、PEC峰值计费及完整成本范围；保留此前37处正式判断和全部准入门槛。运营商页面核实的是设备，不是销售；区域汇总不等于本地预测。

boundary.en: All displayed returns are conditional, pre-tax and unlevered. Paid demand, realized price, full design costs, charger access rights, meter identity, firm capacity/date and enforceable control terms remain unverified. Missing costs and lost sales can reduce returns. No site is promoted to investment-ready status.
boundary.zh: 所有回报均为有条件、税前且不含融资的测算。付费需求、实现价格、完整设计成本、充电通行权、电表归属、确定容量及交期、可执行控制条款仍未核实；缺失成本和损失销量可能压低回报。没有场地升级为可投资状态。

comparisonMethod.en: Five nearby operator pages were checked. Coordinates and straight-line distances use the retained October 29 AFDC inventory, not road routes. The strongest grocery/Tesla match has 11 posts; the closest four-stall comparison uses another network and shared power. None publishes a matched paid-session/energy history. Each comparison retains its AFDC record ID and coordinates for reproduction; operating configuration comes from the current operator page.
comparisonMethod.zh: 核查了五处附近运营商官方页面。坐标及直线距离使用保留的10月29日AFDC清单，不代表道路距离。最匹配的超市/Tesla参照有11枪，较近的四车位参照使用另一网络及共享功率；均未公开可匹配的付费会话/电量历史。 每处保留AFDC记录号及坐标供复算；当前设备配置以运营商页面为依据。

energyMethod.en: 59 sessions and 35 billed kWh imply 2,065 billed kWh/day. Grid energy assumes 15% losses; this is not a measured meter-to-billing reconciliation. A permanent 150 kW site import cap and targeted summer 4CP curtailment are different designs. Daily energy averages cannot establish 15-minute peaks, queues or access rights.
energyMethod.zh: 59次、每次计费35kWh对应每天2,065计费kWh。电网购电量假设损耗15%，并非电表与计费的实测核对。全时150kW场站进口上限与针对夏季4CP的限载是不同方案；日均电量不能证明15分钟峰值、排队表现或通行权。

financialMethod.en: Rebase the working scenarios on the proposed 59-session target: conservative 41.3, base 59 and optimistic 70.8 sessions/site/day, all at 35 billed kWh/session. The retained 70%/100%/120% factors are author-selected stresses, not calibrated probabilities. Retain gross capex $634,500/$564,000/$517,000, scenario construction/ramp/replacement costs, $0.51/kWh realized price, $0.10/kWh service fee and the stated PEC 600 kW monthly/150 kW 4CP profile. Conservative published utility components are stressed by 25%. No grant, growth or residual value is added.
financialMethod.zh: 以59次目标重设工作情景：保守41.3、基准59、乐观70.8次/站/日，均按每次计费35kWh。沿用的70%/100%/120%为作者压力假设，不是校准概率。保留总资本支出634,500/564,000/517,000美元及各情景建设期、爬坡、更新成本，0.51美元/kWh实现价格、0.10美元/kWh服务费，以及PEC月峰600kW/4CP 150kW。保守情景将公开电费分项上调25%；不增加补助、增长或残值。

sensitivityMethod.en: Isolate peak, price, cost and time-shape sensitivities around the 59-session base target. The port-normalized rows explicitly combine 47.2 sessions/day with the stated 22 or 35 kWh/session. Peak-miss cases repeat their established summer average in later years; they do not predict event probabilities. Energy, price and cost increments are alternatives, not quotes or demand estimates, and must not be combined as independent evidence. The 17-hour case changes only the assumed energy time shape; the first-year TCOS transition and fixed rates remain explicit simplifications.
sensitivityMethod.zh: 围绕59次基准目标分别测试峰值、价格、成本及电量时段；单枪归一化各行则明确组合47.2次/日与22或35kWh/次。峰值漏控情景在后续年度重复指定夏季均值，不预测事件概率。单次电量、价格和增量成本只是替代假设，不是报价或需求估计，不能拼接成独立证据。17小时情景仅改变假设电量时段；首年TCOS切换和固定费率仍是明确简化。

costMethod.en: No complete design-matched quote was obtained. The $564,000 base is the retained $470,000 vendor reference plus an unallocated $94,000 allowance, not a priced scope ledger. Nearby public registrations improve scope awareness, but their historical construction estimates exclude specified categories and cannot replace a 2026 four-post third-party budget. Newly identified fees are not added twice to an unallocated allowance.
costMethod.zh: 尚未取得与设计匹配的完整报价。564,000美元基准为保留的470,000美元厂家参照加未分配的94,000美元预留，并非逐项报价。附近公开登记有助于识别范围，但其历史施工估价排除特定类别，不能代替2026年四枪第三方项目预算；新查到的费用不能与未分配预留重复计算。

next.en: The next decision requires a price-matched demand transfer using nearby operator histories, a landlord-approved charging boundary and access hours, PEC service/CIAC and meter confirmation, and a Tesla-accepted peak-control design priced with complete EPC and operating costs. If demand or control cannot meet the unchanged base and downside rules, reject that design rather than relax the gate. No outreach, application, purchase or private-background publication occurred.
next.zh: 下一步判断需要按实际价格匹配的附近运营历史、业主批准的充电范围及开放时段、PEC供电/CIAC及电表确认，以及Tesla接受并纳入完整EPC和运营成本的峰值控制设计。若需求或控制无法满足不变的基准与保守规则，应淘汰该设计，不放宽门槛。本轮没有对外联系、申请、购买或发布私人背景资料。

status.zh: 未核实的较高需求目标

short.en: Nearby stations confirm competition and configurations, not 59 local sales.
short.zh: 附近站点仅确认竞争供给及配置，未证明本址59次销售。

finding.en: 59 on four posts equals 14.75 sessions/post/day and, at 35 kWh, 516.25 billed kWh/post/day—70.9% above the retained vendor energy projection. The selected Publix example reported 59 across five posts; preserving its per-post count would give 47.2 on four posts. Keeping 59 requires 25% more throughput per post. Both transfers remain illustrative.
finding.zh: 四枪59次相当于每枪14.75次；按35kWh计为每枪516.25计费kWh，比保留的厂家电量投影高70.9%。精选Publix案例为五枪59次；保持单枪次数迁移到四枪为47.2次。保持59次需单枪吞吐量增加25%；两者均为示例迁移。

limit.en: No nearby historical paid series or evidence of 59 sessions at $0.51/kWh was obtained. Price elasticity, paid mix, queue losses and competing catchments are unknown; a successful remote example does not calibrate this location.
limit.zh: 未取得附近历史付费序列，也未取得0.51美元/kWh下59次会话的证据。价格弹性、付费组合、排队损失及竞争商圈未知；外地成功案例不能校准本址。

status.zh: 外部量级合理，本地未证实

short.en: The federal aggregate is about 37.81 kWh/session, from another population.
short.zh: 联邦项目汇总约37.81kWh/次，但属于不同样本。

finding.en: The current EV-ChART public page reports 27.6 million kWh and 730,000 sessions through September 2026; division yields 37.81 kWh/session. This makes 35 kWh a reasonable sensitivity input, not a confirmed paid local mean.
finding.zh: 当前EV-ChART公开页报告截至2026年9月累计2,760万kWh、73万次会话，相除为37.81kWh/次。这支持将35kWh作为合理敏感度输入，而不是已确认的本地付费均值。

limit.en: Federal programs, station types and session billing differ. Local dispersion, vehicle mix, meter basis and paid share are unavailable. Retain lower-energy cases rather than replace unknowns with 35.
limit.zh: 联邦项目、站点类型和会话计费方式不同。本地分布、车型组合、计量口径和付费比例未知。应保留较低电量情景，不能用35直接替代未知。

status.zh: 技术上可设想，尚无保证

short.en: A permanent cap and targeted peak curtailment have different service and cost effects.
short.zh: 全时限功率与特定峰值限载对服务和成本影响不同。

finding.en: PEC averages meter demand at four ERCOT 15-minute monthly peaks from June through September. One 600 kW event with the other three at 150 kW raises the average to 262.5 kW. A permanent 150 kW grid cap needs 16.20 equivalent full-power hours to serve 59 × 35 kWh at the assumed loss; it uses 95.27% of theoretical energy capacity in a 17-hour window.
finding.zh: PEC按6月至9月四个ERCOT月度15分钟峰值时段的电表负荷求平均。若一次600kW、其余三次150kW，平均升至262.5kW。在假设损耗下，全时150kW电网功率上限需16.20等效满功率小时才能交付59×35kWh，占17小时窗口理论电量能力的95.27%。

limit.en: No Tesla/PEC agreement guarantees a host-enforceable limit, alert accuracy, control cost or lost-sales allowance. PEC says peaks generally occur 4–6 p.m.; this is not a guaranteed event window. Power sharing alone does not verify a 150 kW grid cap.
limit.zh: 没有Tesla/PEC协议保证业主可执行的功率限制、预警准确率、控制成本或销量损失补偿。PEC称峰值一般在16–18时，但不是保证时窗；功率共享本身不能证明150kW电网进口上限。

status.zh: 范围更明确，完整报价仍缺

short.en: Historical local filings and small official fees do not close the EPC and utility gap.
short.zh: 附近历史登记及少量官方费用不能补齐EPC和接电报价。

finding.en: Nearby Tesla construction registrations show $160,000 for Cedar Park and $315,000 for Georgetown, both filed in 2021. TDLR construction-cost rules exclude acquisition and professional design costs and do not establish how each filing classified EV equipment. These are scope checks, not complete current prices.
finding.zh: 附近Tesla施工登记分别为Cedar Park 160,000美元及Georgetown 315,000美元，均于2021年申报。TDLR施工成本规则排除场地购置和专业设计费用，且不能确定具体登记如何归类EV设备。这些仅用于范围核对，不是当前完整价格。

limit.en: Firm PEC CIAC, full EPC quantities, landlord terms, taxes, control/storage and operating contracts remain unavailable. No historical estimate or general allowance is treated as a fixed quote.
limit.zh: 确定的PEC CIAC、完整EPC工程量、业主条款、税费、控制/储能及运营合同仍未取得；不把历史估价或通用预留当作固定报价。

comparables.name: Whitestone Market / H-E-B Tesla
comparables.address: 2800 E Whitestone Blvd, Cedar Park, TX 78613

observed.en: Official address and configuration; AFDC inventory crosscheck.
observed.zh: 官方地址及配置，与AFDC清单交叉核对。

limit.en: Same grocery/Tesla setting, but 11 versus four posts; no paid history.
limit.zh: 同为超市/Tesla场景，但11枪对比四枪；没有付费历史。

comparables.name: Cedar Park Town Center Tesla
comparables.address: 1001 E Whitestone Blvd, Cedar Park, TX 78613

observed.en: Official address and configuration; AFDC inventory crosscheck.
observed.zh: 官方地址及配置，与AFDC清单交叉核对。

limit.en: Larger established retail site; this is not the separate planned Cypress Creek location. No historical paid sessions or billed energy obtained.
limit.zh: 规模较大的已运营零售站；并非另一个规划中的Cypress Creek地点。 未取得历史付费会话及计费电量。

configuration.en: 4 stalls: two 100 kW units plus a shared 350 kW dual unit
configuration.zh: 4车位：两台100kW及一台共享350kW双枪设备

observed.en: Official address and configuration; AFDC inventory crosscheck.
observed.zh: 官方地址及配置，与AFDC清单交叉核对。

limit.en: Comparable stall count; different network, connectors and shared power. No historical paid sessions or billed energy obtained.
limit.zh: 车位数相同，但网络、接口及共享功率不同。 未取得历史付费会话及计费电量。

comparables.name: EVgo Cedar Park
comparables.address: 700 E Whitestone Blvd, Cedar Park, TX 78613

observed.en: Official address and configuration; AFDC inventory crosscheck.
observed.zh: 官方地址及配置，与AFDC清单交叉核对。

limit.en: Comparable stall count; slower equipment and another network. No historical paid sessions or billed energy obtained.
limit.zh: 车位数相同，但设备功率较低且属于另一网络。 未取得历史付费会话及计费电量。

observed.en: Official address and configuration; AFDC inventory crosscheck.
observed.zh: 官方地址及配置，与AFDC清单交叉核对。

limit.en: Larger retail/interstate catchment; no local billing or energy history.
limit.zh: 规模较大的零售/州际公路商圈；没有本地计费或电量历史。

finding.en: Paren reports Austin metro utilization of 23.1% in Q3 2026. Its definition includes successful and unsuccessful charging activity during tracked open hours.
finding.zh: Paren报告2026年第三季度Austin都市圈利用率23.1%，定义包含跟踪开放时间内的成功及失败充电活动。

limit.en: Proprietary modeled regional aggregate, not paid sessions. On four posts open 24 hours, 59 sessions need 20.49% time utilization at 20 minutes or 30.73% at 30 minutes. Matching 23.1% would require 22.55 minutes under unverified comparability assumptions; this is only an algebraic comparison.
limit.zh: 这是专有模型的区域汇总，不是付费会话。四枪全天开放时，59次对应20分钟会话的20.49%时间利用率或30分钟的30.73%。在未核实且口径不同的假设下，23.1%对应22.55分钟；仅用于代数比较。

finding.en: Austin Energy reports 230 MWh/month, 2.8 GWh in the preceding year and a 6–7 p.m. DCFC peak. Its portfolio has 26 public and four municipal-fleet fast chargers.
finding.zh: Austin Energy报告快充网络每月230MWh、前一年2.8GWh，高峰为18–19时；其资产包括26台公共和4台市政车队快充。

limit.en: The energy denominator does not clearly exclude fleet units. No station sessions or paid mix are supplied. Evening usage warns against assuming curtailment has no sales cost; it does not establish this property’s overlap with ERCOT peaks.
limit.zh: 电量分母没有明确排除车队设备，也没有分站会话或付费组合。晚间使用提示不能假定限载没有销售损失，但不证明本址与ERCOT峰值重合。

finding.en: Tesla’s business-program page claims more than ten U.S. sessions per stall per day. The 59-session four-post target requires 14.75.
finding.zh: Tesla商业项目页面称美国每枪每天超过10次会话；四枪59次目标需要每枪14.75次。

limit.en: A company-wide claim with no stated local distribution or observation period; “over ten” is not an exact ten-session average. It neither proves nor rules out this site.
limit.zh: 这是公司层面主张，没有具体本地分布或观察期间；“超过10次”不等于精确平均10次，既不能证实也不能否定本址。

finding.en: EVgo reports 276 kWh/stall/day for its owned public network in Q2 2026. The target’s 516.25 is about 1.87 times that figure.
finding.zh: EVgo报告2026年第二季度自营公共网络每枪每天276kWh；目标516.25约为其1.87倍。

limit.en: National operator mix, excluding dedicated AV and eXtend, not the two nearby EVgo sites. It is a scale comparison, not a calibrated forecast or failure threshold.
limit.zh: 这是排除专用AV及eXtend后的全国运营商组合，不是附近两处EVgo站点。仅比较量级，不是校准预测或淘汰阈值。

finding.en: EV-ChART’s current public totals imply 37.81 kWh/session across federally funded infrastructure.
finding.zh: EV-ChART当前公开总量推导出联邦资助基础设施每次会话37.81kWh。

limit.en: No matched local paid-energy distribution is available; public totals cannot establish 35 billed kWh at this site.
limit.zh: 没有匹配的本地付费电量分布；公开总量不能确认本址每次计费35kWh。

basis.en: Retained four-post vendor reference $470,000 combines hardware and assumed installation.
basis.zh: 保留的四枪厂家参照470,000美元合并硬件及假设安装。

missing.en: Tesla order quote, freight/tax lines, warranty and exact included commissioning.
missing.zh: 需Tesla订单报价、运费/税费分项、质保及具体调试范围。

item.zh: 土建、电气、无障碍及排水

basis.en: The nearby H-E-B plan at 2800 E Whitestone specifies 11 posts, three cabinets, a transformer foundation, ADA access, conduit, storm-line protection and restoration. Its PEC tie-in/routing was pending utility design. Nearby 2021 filings are historical construction estimates.
basis.zh: 附近2800 E Whitestone的H-E-B图纸列明11枪、三柜、变压器基础、无障碍通行、管道、雨水管保护及恢复；PEC接入及走线当时仍待供电设计。附近2021年登记只是历史施工估价。

missing.en: EPC quantity takeoff covering trenching, conduit, pads, paving, drainage, striping and access. The different-parcel historical plan is an unpriced checklist, not current spare capacity or a scalable four-post quote.
missing.zh: 需EPC工程量报价，覆盖沟槽、管道、基础、路面、排水、标线及通行。 不同地块的历史图纸只是未报价清单，不证明当前剩余容量，也不能线性折算四枪报价。

basis.en: PEC can allocate studies, feeder, transformer and substation costs to the applicant, including overruns. The published $1,000 application band begins at 1 MW; it is not automatically a fee for this assumed 600 kW design.
basis.zh: PEC可将研究、馈线、变压器、变电站及超支费用分配给申请人。 公布的1,000美元申请档从1MW起，不会自动适用于假设600kW方案。

missing.en: PEC CIAC offer, meter and connection drawing, service capacity/date and division of secondary works.
missing.zh: 需PEC CIAC报价、电表及接电图、容量/日期与低压侧工程责任划分。

basis.en: Professional design and site acquisition are excluded from registered construction-cost definitions.
basis.zh: 登记施工成本定义排除专业设计及场地购置。

missing.en: Engineer fees, survey, geotechnical, environmental and final jurisdiction/design review.
missing.zh: 需工程师费用、测量、岩土、环境及最终辖区/设计审查。

item.zh: 州级申报及充电接口登记

basis.en: $175 architectural-barrier filing and $30 per initial registered port: four ports imply $120 where applicable.
basis.zh: 无障碍项目申报175美元，首次登记每接口30美元；适用时四接口为120美元。

missing.en: RAS review/inspection quote, actual registration responsibility and renewal fee; do not double count allowances.
missing.zh: 需RAS审图/检查报价、实际登记责任及续期费用；不得与预留重复计价。

basis.en: Available Leander guidance is historical and directs readers to updated ordinances.
basis.zh: 现有Leander指南为历史文件，并要求查阅更新后的条例。

missing.en: Confirm actual authority and current full permit calculation for the submitted layout.
missing.zh: 需确认实际主管机关及提交布局对应的当前完整许可费用。

basis.en: Appraisal ownership does not establish a charging lease, exclusivity, rent or 24/7 access.
basis.zh: 评估登记业主不等于充电租约、排他权、租金或24小时通行权。

missing.en: Landlord/tenant-approved charger boundary, easements, rent, escalation and restoration terms.
missing.zh: 需业主/租户批准的充电范围、地役权、租金、递增及恢复条款。

item.en: Tax, insurance and recurring site costs
item.zh: 税费、保险及经常性场地成本

basis.en: The $1,000/month base non-utility cost remains unquoted; account-specific taxes are not resolved.
basis.zh: 基准每月1,000美元非电费成本仍无报价，特定账户税费未确定。

missing.en: Matched insurance, cleaning, accounting, permit renewal, property/transaction taxes and landlord budget.
missing.zh: 需匹配的保险、清洁、会计、许可续期、财产/交易税及业主预算。

basis.en: Power-sharing capability is documented; a 150 kW meter-control package is not quoted or contractually confirmed.
basis.zh: 已说明功率共享能力，但150kW电表控制方案没有报价或合同确认。

missing.en: Tesla-accepted controls, communications, fail-safe, verification, fees, lost sales and battery EPC if selected.
missing.zh: 需Tesla接受的控制、通信、失效保护、验证、费用、损失销量，以及选用储能时的EPC。

basis.en: The $0.10/kWh service fee and 1.5% base annual replacement reserve remain working assumptions.
basis.zh: 每kWh 0.10美元服务费及基准每年1.5%更新预留仍是工作假设。

missing.en: Signed service/warranty exclusions, replacement obligations and end-of-lease decommissioning.
missing.zh: 需签署的服务/质保除外条款、更新责任及租期结束拆除恢复义务。

item.zh: 预备费、融资及营运资金

basis.en: The $94,000 base uplift is 20% of the vendor reference, not an itemized quote. Financing is excluded.
basis.zh: 基准94,000美元增额为厂家参照的20%，不是逐项报价；不含融资。

missing.en: Reconciled total without overlap, draw schedule, working capital and funding terms.
missing.zh: 需无重叠的总成本核对、提款计划、营运资金及融资条款。

result.en: Five operator pages and exact-location searches yielded equipment and address facts, not historical paid exports. Tesla price headings returned no amounts; EVgo directs live prices to its app or charger.
result.zh: 五处运营商页面及精确地点搜索取得设备和地址事实，未取得历史付费导出。Tesla价格栏未返回金额；EVgo将实时核价引导至App或设备。

next.en: Obtain 90–365 days of operator energy, paid sessions, actual prices, uptime and hourly patterns; match ports, competing supply and customer mix.
next.zh: 取得运营商90–365天电量、付费会话、实际价格、正常运行率及时段记录，并匹配枪数、竞争供给及客户组合。

result.en: Paren advertises station-level daily/weekly exports behind a demo route. EV-ChART limits detailed access to funding recipients and authorized parties. Neither dataset was purchased or requested.
result.zh: Paren通过演示申请提供分站日/周导出；EV-ChART详细访问限资助接收方及获授权人员。本轮均未购买或申请。

next.en: Use an authorized operator export or a separately approved data-access route with definitions, coverage and licensing disclosed.
next.zh: 使用获授权的运营商导出，或另行批准的数据获取路径，并说明定义、覆盖范围及许可。

result.en: PEC rules and the ERCOT report catalog were available; settled event files and a current enforceable Tesla control offer were not obtained.
result.zh: 已取得PEC规则及ERCOT报告目录，未取得已结算事件文件或当前可执行的Tesla控制报价。

next.en: Match the site meter to settled 15-minute events; obtain control acceptance, alert windows, fail-safe tests and queue/lost-sales analysis.
next.zh: 将场站电表匹配到已结算15分钟事件；取得控制认可、预警时窗、失效保护测试及排队/损失销量分析。

result.en: Historical nearby registrations and current fee/utility rules were found. No Ronald Reagan charger-specific EPC, CIAC or lease package was obtained. Adjacent convenience-store remodel costs were excluded. The nearby H-E-B regulator-hosted plan was downloaded and relevant pages inspected; it supplies scope, not prices.
result.zh: 已找到附近历史登记和当前费用/供电规则，未取得Ronald Reagan充电项目专属EPC、CIAC或租约文件；已排除相邻便利店改造成本。 已下载并检查监管机构保存的附近H-E-B相关图纸页，取得范围信息而非价格。

next.en: Reconcile written Tesla, EPC, PEC and landlord scopes against one approved layout, including taxes, control and recurring costs.
next.zh: 围绕同一获批布局，核对Tesla、EPC、PEC及业主书面范围，纳入税费、控制及经常性成本。
